description: List the most recent project snapshots for a workspace (compact metadata only — no file_tree, no sampled_contents). Use to find which snapshot to read in full. Up to 25 per call, ordered newest first.

source.description: Filter to snapshots taken from a specific Pathrule surface.

name: pathrule_list_snapshots

data.description: Snapshot metadata list. Load one in full with pathrule_read_snapshot.

snapshots.description: Newest first. Metadata only: id, source, project_name, git_remote_url, branch, git_head, file_count, total_size_bytes, created_at.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

human_message.description: One-line summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

title: Pathrule List Project Snapshots
